templates.why_chosen: The AFC Server is the hub: a 2x3 grid packs six named functions into one box, flanked by a client access point on one side and two distinct NRA databases as spokes on the other.
templates.what_to_learn: When a hub's real content is a set of named functions rather than repeated workers, lay them out as a small labelled grid inside the hub box, but add a legend or colour convention separating request/response traffic from the database-feed arrows, since this exemplar leaves both unlabelled by anything but position.
